boundary: Read-only static census. Unique-pool totals avoid shared pi/mbase double counting. No frequency, actual opacity, brightness, line-of-sight or runtime claims.
production_reference: LightAndDarkness git c5a04c4 (0.4.1); working source intentionally not used.

renderer_evidence.world_fon: World:429 vfon precedes visual; 1063 draws land.act.fon; Grafon:310-324 fallback fonDefault.
renderer_evidence.backdrop: Grafon:728-759 tiles backwall bitmap or skips sky; backform 1/2/3 supplies geometry.
renderer_evidence.opening_alpha: Grafon:547-608 background object masks; 639-647 preserves final backBmp alpha for transpFon or sky.
renderer_evidence.coordinate_boundary: visFon belongs to world.vfon and setFonSize is screen sized; visBack/visBack2/frontBmp use world coordinates. Use display transforms when sampling.
renderer_evidence.known_gap: Frozen LadEnvironment:44 sees transpFon only for daylight classification; skyAt:48-55 checks sky/backform, not bitmap openings. WINDOWS:16 omits enil; no hole masks or texture openings.
renderer_evidence.shared_trials: GameData prob is a pool registration. Land.buildProb:783-789 takes its XML but constructs with this.newLoc; 947 passes the hosting Land to Location. Default fon/backwall/color/darkness therefore depend on host region, not prob's empty options.

generation_rules.status: assignment is to parameter object after Location construction; do not count as active room override
